project_info.theme: Techcom Insurance Song An health protection plan
project_info.color_palette: Light blue, white, black, bright red, soft hospital blue

main_subject.detail: A family-health insurance poster with 'TECHCOMINSURANCE' at top left and 'TECHCOMBANK' at top right. The headline reads 'Bao hiem suc khoe Techcom Insurance SONG AN' and the subheadline says 'Song hanh bu dap - An tam vien phi'. Three benefit columns list 'Han muc bao ve toi 2.1 ty VND', '160 benh hiem ngheo, benh thong thuong va tai nan', and 'Phi chi tu 499K/nam'. In the lower half, a smiling father, mother, and daughter stand in a softly blurred hospital or clinic environment while the father touches a glowing digital medical shield with a white cross.
main_subject.style: Clean family-protection healthcare poster with soft hospital ambience, realistic family portrait, and benefit-infographic layout
